name: io.github.tonyyang0504/contrado-mcp
description: Contrado (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_order. Every tool maps to a docu

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CONTRADO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Contrado Helix private token (Contrado Store Account > API Integration; shown once at creation), sent as `X-API-Key`. Scopes: StoresRead, StoreProductsRead, StoreOrdersRead.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CONTRADO_STORE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Store id sent as `X-Store-Id`; needed only with an account-level token (a store-level token already names its store).
